p_intro: The 100 Dev Mistakes app (the "App") values your privacy. This policy explains what information the App collects and how it is used.
p_collect_lead: The App stores the following data locally on your device:
p_collect_li1: Checklist progress (which mistakes you have checked off)
p_collect_li2: Reflection journal entries (answers you write yourself)
p_collect_sync: This data may be synced through iCloud (CloudKit), linked to your Apple ID, across devices signed in with the same Apple ID.
p_not_li1: Personally identifiable information such as name, email address, or phone number
p_not_li3: Device access permissions such as contacts, camera, or microphone
p_not_li4: Usage analytics data or advertising tracking
p_third: The App does not sell or share any collected data with third parties.
p_icloud: If you use iCloud sync, your data is transmitted and stored through Apple's CloudKit infrastructure. Apple's privacy policy applies to the handling of that data. Apple Privacy Policy: {apple_link}
p_iap: Subscriptions and in-app purchases are processed through the Apple App Store. Apple handles your payment information, and the app developer cannot access it.
p_delete: You can delete all data stored in the App from Settings → "Reset All Data" in the app. To delete data synced to iCloud, go to iOS Settings → Apple ID → iCloud → Manage Storage and delete it there.
p_child: The App does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 14.
p_change: If this privacy policy changes, we will update this page. Significant changes will be announced through an app update.
p_contact: If you have any questions about privacy, please contact us through the contact information on the developer's App Store page.
su_intro: Need help with 100 Dev Mistakes? Check the frequently asked questions below first.
su_contact: If you have a problem or a suggestion, please reach out through the contact information on the developer's App Store page.
q1: How do I use my PRO purchase on another device?
a1: Sign in with the same Apple ID, then tap "Restore Purchases" on the subscription screen.
q2: How do I cancel my subscription?
a2: You can manage and cancel it anytime in iOS Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
q3: My data isn't syncing between devices.
a3: Make sure every device is signed in to iCloud with the same Apple ID and that iCloud is turned on for this app in iOS Settings. A network connection is also required.
q4: I want to erase all my saved data.
a4: Tap "Reset All Data" in the app's settings to delete your checklist, reflections, and bookmarks. This can't be undone.
q5: Which devices can I use it on?
a5: You can use it on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
